title: Should Students Wear Uniforms?
text:
Many students ask whether school uniforms should be required. In a persuasive essay, the writer must state a clear opinion and support it with good reasons. For example, uniforms can reduce the pressure to wear expensive clothes. They can also help students feel that they belong to the same school community.

However, some people argue that uniforms limit self-expression. A strong essay answers this objection directly. The writer might say that students can still show their personality through hobbies, books and art, not only through clothes. Therefore, the best argument is one that respects both the school and the student.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what can uniforms reduce?
options: The pressure to wear expensive clothes

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what do some people argue about uniforms?
What can be inferred about the writer's purpose in the essay?
options: To persuade the reader to take a clear position
To describe the history of school clothing
To tell a personal story about school

questions.text: What does the writer suggest a good persuasive essay should do?

vocabulary.definition: trying to convince the reader to agree with an opinion
a feeling that someone must do something because others expect it
a reason given to disagree with an idea or argument
to be part of a group and feel accepted in it

paragraph_translations: Muitos estudantes perguntam se os uniformes escolares deveriam ser obrigatórios. Em uma redação persuasiva, o autor deve afirmar uma opinião clara e apoiá-la com boas razões. Por exemplo, os uniformes podem reduzir a pressão para usar roupas caras. Eles também podem ajudar os alunos a sentir que pertencem à mesma comunidade escolar.

No entanto, algumas pessoas argumentam que os uniformes limitam a autoexpressão. Uma redação forte responde a essa objeção diretamente. O autor pode dizer que os estudantes ainda podem mostrar sua personalidade por meio de hobbies, livros e arte, não apenas pela roupa. Portanto, o melhor argumento é aquele que respeita tanto a escola quanto o aluno.
